numerology.title: Numerology
numerology.configure: Enter your birth date and name
numerology.name: Full name (optional)
numerology.consent: I agree to send these inputs to calculate my numbers. Names and birth dates are not stored in the database or account history.
numerology.method: Add the digits and reduce, keeping 11/22/33. Names use unaccented A–Z letters; AEIOU are vowels and Y is a consonant.

calendar.title: Sources and calendar download

calendar.checked: The lunar date matches the server result.
calendar.mismatch: The engines disagree. Send feedback for review before relying on this result.
calendar.source: Existing algorithm reference: Hồ Ngọc Đức; usage rights and golden reference data require validation before releasing extensions.
